name: Glass Thinning Etchant
description: Glass Thinning Etchant (GGE Series) is a proprietary chemical formulation designed for controlled thinning of glass substrates used in flat panel display manufacturing. The etchant enables uniform thickness reduction of large-area glass panels while maintaining surface quality and planarity. Glass thinning is a critical process in modern FPD manufacturing to reduce display module weight and thickness for mobile and automotive applications. The GGE series provides multiple formulation options to accommodate different glass compositions (aluminosilicate, borosilicate) and target thickness requirements. Process optimization support is available for integration into existing wet bench or spray tool configurations.
